20032.en: Note that X_20032-X_20034 are real if and only if ABC is an acute triangle.
no: Let ABC be an acute triangle, and let * A'B'C' = medial triangle * A''B''C'' = orthic triangle * U = circumcircle * O_{A} = circle through A' and A'' tangent to U on the negative side of line BC; define O_{B} and O_{C} cyclically Then X(20032 is the radical center of the circles O_{A}, O_{B}, O_{C}.
See Kadir Altintas and Peter Moses, **X_20032** (``X_20032.ggb``). See also X_20033 and X_20034.

20033.t: TOUCHPOINT OF THE NINE-POINT CIRCLE AND ALTINTAS CIRCLE
20033.en: The circle externally tangent to O_{A}, O_{B}, O_{C} constructed at X_20032, and here named the **Altintas circle,**, is tangent to the nine-point circle, and X_20033 is the touchpoint. See X_20032
